dz: 罗伯特·卡维利埃·德·拉·萨勒发现了密西西比河口,为法国宣称并取名路易斯安那.
de: Robert Cavelier de La Salle discovers the mouth of the Mississippi River, claims it for France and names it Louisiana.

t: 西班牙的菲利普三世颁布"驱逐摩里斯克人"的法令.
te: Philip III of Spain issues the decree of the "Expulsion of the Moriscos".
dz: 西班牙的菲利普三世颁布"驱逐摩里斯克人"的法令.
de: Philip III of Spain issues the decree of the "Expulsion of the Moriscos".

t: 西班牙与荷兰共和国签署"安特卫普条约",启动十二年停战.
te: Spain and the Dutch Republic sign the Treaty of Antwerp to initiate twelve years of truce.
dz: 八十年战争:西班牙与荷兰共和国签署"安特卫普条约",启动十二年停战.
de: Eighty Years' War: Spain and the Dutch Republic sign the Treaty of Antwerp to initiate twelve years of truce.

t: 重新定居的什叶派穆斯林在Şahkulu领导下起兵反抗奥斯曼帝国.
te: Resettled Shiite Muslims rise up in the Şahkulu rebellion under the leadership of Şahkulu against the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 重新定居的什叶派穆斯林在Şahkulu领导下起兵反抗奥斯曼帝国.
de: Resettled Shiite Muslims rise up in the Şahkulu rebellion under the leadership of Şahkulu against the Ottoman Empire.

t: 洛地条约已经签署,在意大利北部城邦之间建立了近50年的权力平衡.
te: The Treaty of Lodi is signed, establishing a balance of power among northern Italian city-states for almost 50 years.
dz: 洛地条约已经签署,在意大利北部城邦之间建立了近50年的权力平衡.
de: The Treaty of Lodi is signed, establishing a balance of power among northern Italian city-states for almost 50 years.

t: 费拉拉理事会从首届会议开始,君士坦丁堡牧首,安提阿、亚历山大和耶路撒冷牧首会议的代表和教宗尤金…
te: The Council of Ferrara begins with its first session in presence of the Patriarch of Constantinople, representatives of…
dz: 费拉拉理事会从首届会议开始,君士坦丁堡牧首,安提阿、亚历山大和耶路撒冷牧首会议的代表和教宗尤金四世主持会议.
de: The Council of Ferrara begins with its first session in presence of the Patriarch of Constantinople, representatives of the Patriarchal Sees of Antioch, Alexandria and Jerusalem and Pope Eugene IV presiding.

t: 1,但老瑞士邦联的军队在Näfels战役中战胜了奥地利的Archduchy.
te: 1, forces of the Old Swiss Confederacy are victorious over the Archduchy of Austria in the Battle of Näfels.
dz: 尽管人数已超过16:1,但老瑞士邦联的军队在Näfels战役中战胜了奥地利的Archduchy.
de: Despite being outnumbered 16:1, forces of the Old Swiss Confederacy are victorious over the Archduchy of Austria in the Battle of Näfels.

t: 拜占庭城市特萨洛尼克向奥斯曼人投降,虽然统治在安卡拉战役后重新回到了拜占庭.
te: The Byzantine city of Thessalonike surrenders to the Ottomans, though rule reverts back to the Byzantines after the bat…
dz: 拜占庭城市特萨洛尼克向奥斯曼人投降,虽然统治在安卡拉战役后重新回到了拜占庭.
de: The Byzantine city of Thessalonike surrenders to the Ottomans, though rule reverts back to the Byzantines after the battle of Ankara.

t: 袁军在今越南北部的巴赫当战役被特伦部队击败.
te: Yuan forces are defeated by Trần forces in the Battle of Bach Dang in present-day northern Vietnam.
dz: 蒙古入侵越南:袁军在今越南北部的巴赫当战役被特伦部队击败.
de: Mongol invasions of Vietnam: Yuan forces are defeated by Trần forces in the Battle of Bach Dang in present-day northern Vietnam.

t: 利格尼茨战役:蒙古军击败了波兰和德军.
te: Mongol forces defeat the Polish and German armies.
dz: 利格尼茨战役:蒙古军击败了波兰和德军.
de: Battle of Liegnitz: Mongol forces defeat the Polish and German armies.

t: 拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯接获所承诺的援军1600名骑兵,多为匈奴或斯拉夫人血统和专家弓人. 尽管…
te: The Byzantine general Belisarius receives his promised reinforcements, 1,600 cavalry, mostly of Hunnic or Slavic origin…
dz: 围攻罗马:拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯接获所承诺的援军1600名骑兵,多为匈奴或斯拉夫人血统和专家弓人. 尽管短缺,他开始袭击哥特人营地和维地格斯,但被迫陷入僵局.
de: Siege of Rome: The Byzantine general Belisarius receives his promised reinforcements, 1,600 cavalry, mostly of Hunnic or Slavic origin and expert bowmen. Despite shortages, he starts raids against the Gothic camps and Vitiges but is forced into a stalemate.

t: 拜占庭皇帝巴西利斯库斯向其帝国的主教们发了一封通函(Enkyklikon),支持单体基督教立场.
te: Byzantine Emperor Basiliscus issues a circular letter (Enkyklikon) to the bishops of his empire, supporting the Monophy…
dz: 拜占庭皇帝巴西利斯库斯向其帝国的主教们发了一封通函(Enkyklikon),支持单体基督教立场.
de: Byzantine Emperor Basiliscus issues a circular letter (Enkyklikon) to the bishops of his empire, supporting the Monophysite christological position.

t: 杰出的士兵Septimius Severus被军队在伊利里库姆宣布为皇帝.
te: The distinguished soldier Septimius Severus is proclaimed emperor by the army in Illyricum.
dz: 杰出的士兵Septimius Severus被军队在伊利里库姆宣布为皇帝.
de: The distinguished soldier Septimius Severus is proclaimed emperor by the army in Illyricum.
